title: Account Credit Deposit Credit on Inbound Transfer Price Matches (Domain Registrations)
content:
**Basis Q&A — Domain Registrations, Domain Care price match on an inbound transfer charge**

The transfer line's volume credit, one of the charge's Domain Care credits, turns on the account credit deposits the customer has posted to their Harborline Customer Accounts account.

**What is the rule?**
The transfer line's volume credit is USD 0.50 for each year the charge covered where the account credit deposits posted on the customer's account less than 12 whole months before the day of the price match total USD 5000.00 or more, USD 0.25 for each year the charge covered where they total at least USD 250.00 but less than USD 5000.00, and nothing where they total less, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached.

**Which entries count?**
Only deposits into the account credit on the customer's Harborline Customer Accounts account. Other entries on the account credit do not enter the total.

**How is the 12-month window read?**
A deposit counts while fewer than 12 whole months separate its posting date from the day of the price match, a month being complete only once its day of the month is reached. For a price match made on 20 May 2029 (hypothetical), a deposit posted on 21 May 2028 is 11 whole months old and counts; a deposit posted on 20 May 2028 is 12 whole months old and does not.

**What happens at the thresholds?**

| Deposits in the window | Volume credit |
|---|---|
| USD 5000.00 exactly, or more | USD 0.50 for each year the charge covered |
| USD 4999.99 | USD 0.25 for each year the charge covered |
| USD 250.00 exactly | USD 0.25 for each year the charge covered |
| USD 249.99, or nothing deposited | nothing |

**Example (hypothetical).** Deposits of USD 180.00 and USD 95.00 inside the window total USD 275.00, so a charge covering 1 year earns a volume credit of USD 0.25.
